Subject: Dedicated capacity discovery recap  Aurora Finance

Hi Alice / Ben 

Thanks again for taking the time today  really helpful conversation. Quick recap of what we heard and proposed next steps so we have alignment. Please flag anything I missed.

Summary of pain points
- Tail latency variability during peak reconciliation windows is causing downstream SLA breaches for reporting jobs (95th percentile spikes to ~2.4s).
- Cost unpredictability with cloud burst GPUs; finance wants better unit economics for high-throughput batch scoring.
- Data isolation and auditability requirements for regulated customer PII.

Current stack and constraints
- Inference runs as a mix of on-prem pre-processing + GCP-hosted model endpoints (mixed single- and multi-GPU instances).
- Typical batch windows: nightly reconciliation (3090 min) and ad-hoc realtime scoring during business hours (50200 TPS).
- Compliance: SOC2 + annual audit; certain customer data must remain in a designated VPC.

Success criteria for a Dedicated fit
- Predictable throughput: sustained 150 TPS with 95th p99 latency <350ms for the realtime path.
- Cost: target 2535% reduction in per-token/unit inference cost vs current burst model during steady-state.
- Isolation: dedicated GPU pools in a VPC with KMS integration and audit logs for all inference requests.

Proposed Redwood Dedicated configuration (initial sizing)
- Reserved pool: 4x A40-equivalent GPUs for steady throughput + 2x burst GPUs for peak windows.
- Autoscaling policy: scheduled scale-up for nightly window (automatic add of 2 GPUs at 02:00 UTC), burst on queue depth with soft cap and fallbacks to hosted variants.
- Network & security: private peering + KMS integration; audit log retention 365 days.

Open questions we agreed to follow up on
1) Exact TPS distribution during the peak 90-minute reconciliation window (you said sample logs available)  request: send a 2472 hour trace if possible.
2) Any hard SLAs for recovery time on failover (RTO expectations).
3) Contracting: preferred term length (12 vs 24 months) and billing cadence.

Attachments: I attached a short draft scope and an initial ballpark estimate (dedicated_capacity_estimate.xlsx).

Next steps
- Alice/Ben: share the 2472h inference trace and confirm preferred contract term (target by EOD Thu).
- Marissa/Rafael: well follow up with a formal sizing + pricing sheet and a proposed mutual action plan (by Mon 3/9).
- Schedule: Ill send a calendar invite this week for a technical deep-dive with Lukas and your infra lead.

If that looks right Ill spin up the sizing doc and loop in procurement.

Best,
